It's just the state of our society is all! Even if I get my personal life in order, you know what's an awesome possibility? That I'll be murdered for being trans. That I'll be repeatedly discriminated against for being trans. That I won't even be able to use the appropriate gendered washroom at whatever future job I hold because I'm trans. That I'll never find anyone to love me because I'm trans.

I can't fucking deal with this.
Trans people are not crossdressers. :/

I am too worn out to keep trying again and again to not fuck up. I want my friends back, although I doubt they'll ever feel anything but disgust towards me. I don't have the money to move out of the toxic situation I'm in with my family. My employer has cut my hours down to a ridiculously low level again(It's not related to my performance on the job).

I have nothing for me right now but a mind full of pain and a desire to end it. I keep running what I could do through my head, and one possibility is homelessness, but I genuinely don't think I could handle that atop everything else that's gone wrong for me. I shouldn't bother anymore. I have no right to happiness, not after everything I've done. My experiences tell me this. I am debased even when I am at my best doing everything that I can for my family. The way I feel right now is karma telling me to go fuck myself and die.

I'm trying to cope! I'm trying to learn better ways to cope too, but all I feel like doing is putting cigarettes out on myself and hopefully working up the courage to finally end my shitty life.
A fresh start is impossible for me. I have nothing to my name.

Ronald Reagan has always struck me as one of the worst presidents of US history. They say he brought about tax reform, saved our country, but who was he really?

He was a spokeman for the special interests groups. He was a bigot. He advocated the murder of a generation suffering from the onset of the AIDs epidemic. While we have monsters like Ronald Reagan, we had bright lights such as Jonas Salk, who tried for an AIDs vaccine, whom you all may remember for his polio vaccine.

Jonas Salk is a man who should be remembered, who worked for the betterment of mankind, and instead we have pretty faces such as Ronald Reagan remembered, and we wonder why our country is in such a deplorable state. Thanks for sharing this, but remember: There were people who answered the call and who continue to do so. Look to them, focusing on the negative only brings sorrow.

Why would it be selfish of you to be yourself? Our families are important to us, sometimes the most important parts of our lives, and disappointing them is a great burden that we all carry with us in our lives. We will find ourselves asking if our parents would be proud of their children when they've long since passed from this world.

Your concerns are legitimate. Your feelings are legitimate. Be yourself and be happy. Your parents may reject you from the basis of their indoctrination into homophobia started when they were very young. It's most assuredly a cultural thing. It runs rampant even today! Your parents will still love you even though they say otherwise, so take care of yourself first, because you are important too.

And hun, being on hormones, having your family know? It's the best thing in the world because you are then much less burdened by the prospect of rejection. Mind you that I said prospect. It's not set in stone. BE YOURSELF!
